Website Critique Assignment Submitted by: Sakshi Desai Company: Eragina Digital Solutions Website Reviewed: https://www.doright.world

1. Design Review

The overall design of the website lacks visual appeal.  The color scheme is dull and not vibrant, which makes the content less engaging.  The navigation bar only has two buttons, which makes the website feel incomplete and confusing.

The images used are not attractive and do not capture attention or reflect the brand effectively.

2. User Experience Review

The website is simple, but it does not offer a smooth and interactive experience for



users. Important sections like “About Us,” “Contact,” or “Services” are missing from the top menu.

There are no clear call-to-action (CTA) buttons to guide users.  The content feels disconnected and does not highlight the purpose of the website well.

3. Suggestions for Improvement

Use a more vibrant and modern color scheme to improve visual engagement.  Add more navigation options such as “About,” “Services,” and “Contact” for better usability.

Replace current images with high-quality and brand-relevant visuals.  Add clear CTA buttons like “Learn More,” “Get Involved,” or “Join Us” to guide



user flow. Improve the homepage layout with well-defined sections and headlines to make it easier for visitors to understand the website’s mission.

Thank you!
